plain_meaning: Where the person is in their education or career right now.
question_it_answers: Are they at school, in college, job hunting, or already working?
allowed_values: School, Post school, College early, College final, Fresher, Working 0 to 2 yrs, Working 3 to 5 yrs, Working 5 yrs plus, Career switcher, Parent, Already studying a qualification, Retaking an exam, Unknown
can_affect: Cohort, playbook, fit score, which resource is sent, message wording, contact timing
depends_on: Nothing. This is a root dimension.
conflicts_with: Course interest, when the course does not suit the stage
how_calculated: Declared value wins. Otherwise inferred from source and qualification. Unknown is a valid answer and is never guessed in copy.
confidence_rule: Declared, Inferred high, Inferred low, Unknown. Copy that names the life stage is blocked below Inferred high.

plain_meaning: Which course they are asking about, and how precisely they asked.
question_it_answers: Do they want a named course, a category, or just a direction?
allowed_values: Exact ask, Named course, Category only, Direction only, Unknown
can_affect: Cohort, playbook, fit score, intent score, which resource is sent, message wording
cannot_affect: Eligibility. Naming a course does not make you eligible for it.
depends_on: Life stage for suitability. Source context when the course is inferred from a landing page.
conflicts_with: Life stage when the course does not suit the stage. Eligibility when the course is closed to them.
how_calculated: An explicit statement wins. A landing page or campaign produces only a low confidence guess that must be confirmed in the message, never asserted.
confidence_rule: Declared or Inferred low. Guessed values must be confirmed with a question before any commercial step.

plain_meaning: Whether they are allowed to take the course, and whether it is the right step for them now.
question_it_answers: Can they sit this exam, and is this the right course for where they are?
allowed_values: Eligible, Eligible with condition, Not yet eligible, Too early for this course, Overqualified for this course, Needs checking, Unknown
can_affect: Cohort, playbook, fit score, priority, whether a payment link may be issued, message wording
cannot_affect: Intent score. Someone ineligible can still be very keen.
conflicts_with: Course interest, when they ask for something closed to them
how_calculated: Checked against the awarding body rules held in a versioned reference table. Never inferred from age or city.
confidence_rule: Verified, Assumed or Unknown. Unknown blocks payment links until a counsellor confirms.

plain_meaning: Whether they can realistically do the course: time, money, and who signs off.
question_it_answers: Do they have the hours, the budget and the authority to say yes?
allowed_values: Hours: 15 plus, 8 to 14, under 8, unknown. Budget: covers the price, needs instalments, price sensitive, not disclosed. Decision maker: self, parent, employer, shared, unknown
can_affect: Fit score, which course variant is recommended, which resource is sent, whether a parent or employer is brought in
depends_on: Life stage, for who the decision maker usually is
conflicts_with: Course interest, when the variant needs more hours than they have
how_calculated: Declared only. Never inferred from city, college or job title.
confidence_rule: Declared or Unknown. Unknown scores neutral, never negative.

plain_meaning: What we already know about this person from before.
question_it_answers: Are they new, a past lead, or already a paying student?
allowed_values: New, Past lead lost, Past lead dormant, Attended an event only, Past student, Active student
can_affect: Cohort, playbook, fit score, message opening, who owns the lead, whether acquisition messaging is allowed at all
depends_on: Nothing. Resolved by matching the phone number against the student master.
conflicts_with: Life stage, when an active student is misread as a new lead
how_calculated: Phone number matched against the student master on the last ten digits, then lead history.

plain_meaning: Where they came from, and what that source already promised them.
question_it_answers: What do they already know, and what were they told to expect?
allowed_values: 45 source values grouped into: Organic, Paid, Referral, Campus, Direct inbound, Existing database, Cross sell, Reactivation, Unknown
can_affect: Message opening, which resource is sent, response time target, intent score, whether a promise must be delivered first
cannot_affect: Fit score and cohort. Only inbound calls, walk ins and existing student matches change the cohort.
conflicts_with: Location, when the event city differs from where they live
how_calculated: Taken from the form, the CRM source, or the attribution cookie. Never guessed.
confidence_rule: Verified or Unknown. Unknown falls back to a neutral opening.

plain_meaning: What they have actually done since we contacted them.
question_it_answers: Are they opening, clicking, watching, replying?
source_fields: message_read_count, link_click_count, resource_opened_ids, resource_completion_pct, demo_attended, counselling_attended, days_since_last_engagement
allowed_values: None, Passive: opened only, Active: clicked or replied, Deep: completed a resource, attended a class or a call
can_affect: Intent score, which resource is sent next, priority, whether a counsellor is triggered
depends_on: Source context, for what was sent in the first place
conflicts_with: Stated urgency, when someone says they are ready but does nothing for three weeks
how_calculated: Counted from tracking events. Completing something is worth more than opening it. Replying is worth more than clicking.
confidence_rule: Verified by event. Absence of tracking is recorded as unknown, not as zero engagement.

plain_meaning: What they have told us about their timeline, and what they have asked for.
question_it_answers: How soon do they say they want to start, and what have they asked us for?
allowed_values: Ready now, Within a month, One to three months, Later, Undecided, Blocked by an objection
can_affect: Intent score, priority, playbook, contact cadence, whether a counsellor is triggered
depends_on: Course interest, for the attempt calendar
conflicts_with: Engagement, when stated urgency is not matched by any activity
how_calculated: Declared statements plus transactional requests. A request for a fee, a batch date, an instalment plan or a payment link is the strongest single signal.
confidence_rule: Declared. Re verified after 14 days because declared urgency goes stale.

plain_meaning: Where they are, and what that makes practical.
question_it_answers: Can they attend in person, what language, and when can we call?
source_fields: city, state_region, city_tier, distance_to_centre_km, preferred_language, time_zone
allowed_values: City tier 1, 2, 3, International or Unknown. In person reachable: yes or no
can_affect: Message wording, which resource is sent for mode, whether an in person option is offered, call timing, template language, which testimonial is used as proof
cannot_affect: Fit score, intent score, priority, cohort and tone. City tier must never change how urgently or how warmly someone is treated.
depends_on: Nothing. Derived from the address or phone.
conflicts_with: Source context, when an event location differs from the home city
how_calculated: City is matched to a city master that carries tier, nearest centre, distance and time zone.
confidence_rule: Verified by match, or Unknown. Unknown suppresses every location reference in copy.
